classification.difficultyReason: Select the right-angle, straight-angle or revolution total and add or subtract the displayed sectors, identifying the reflex region where requested. Each part directly applies one taught angle relationship.

inlines.text: in each diagram below, giving reasons for your answer. In parts g and j, find the reflex angle

spec.description: Straight line COB and upper-left ray OA.
spec.mathematics: C,O,B are collinear; angle COA is 28 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 28-degree angle is visible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+28^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle AOB&=152^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in the straight angle $\angle COB$ add to $180^\circ$.

spec.mathematics: Angle BOC is 90 degrees and angle AOC is 25 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+25^\circ&=90^\circ\\\angle AOB&=65^\circ\end{align*}$$
The adjacent angles form right angle $\angle BOC$.

spec.mathematics: Angle BON is 46 degrees; angle NOA is a right angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied angle and right-angle mark are visible.

answer.worked:
$$\angle AOB=90^\circ+46^\circ=136^\circ$$
Adjacent angles at $O$ can be added.

spec.description: Straight angle XOB divided by OY and OA.
spec.mathematics: Angle XOY is 40 degrees; angle YOA is 112 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+112^\circ+40^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle AOB&=28^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in the straight angle $\angle XOB$ add to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Straight line AOB with marked vertex O. The source red point is rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: A,O,B lie on a straight line in that order.

answer.worked: $\angle AOB=180^\circ$, because $A$, $O$ and $B$ lie on a straight line.

spec.mathematics: Angle BOM is 105 degrees and angle MOA is 20 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two givens are labelled.

answer.worked:
$$\angle AOB=20^\circ+105^\circ=125^\circ$$
Adjacent angles at $O$ can be added.

spec.description: Five rays and a curved mark identifying the reflex sector.
spec.mathematics: Successive non-reflex sectors from OA to OB are 33,30,27,24 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Reflex angle is marked but its value is hidden.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{reflex }\angle AOB+33^\circ+30^\circ+27^\circ+24^\circ&=360^\circ\\\text{reflex }\angle AOB&=246^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.

spec.description: Four rays around O, with right angle BON.
spec.mathematics: Angle BON is 90 degrees; NOM and MOA are each 70 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+90^\circ+70^\circ+70^\circ&=360^\circ\\\angle AOB&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.

spec.description: Straight line BOJ with five upper rays; 5-degree label has an external curved pointer.
spec.mathematics: From OJ towards OA the sectors are 5,15,25,35,45 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+45^\circ+35^\circ+25^\circ+15^\circ+5^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle AOB&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in the straight angle $\angle BOJ$ add to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Five rays clockwise from OA to OB; left curved mark selects the reflex angle.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{reflex }\angle AOB+40^\circ+42^\circ+44^\circ+46^\circ&=360^\circ\\\text{reflex }\angle AOB&=188^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.

spec.description: Three distinct rays from O, with external O label and curved pointer. C,O,A are not collinear.
spec.mathematics: Angles COA and BOC are each 165 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The small angle AOB is unlabelled.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+165^\circ+165^\circ&=360^\circ\\\angle AOB&=30^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.

spec.description: Seven rays in clockwise order A,B,C,D,E,F,G.
spec.mathematics: Successive known angles BOC,COD,DOE,EOF,FOG,GOA are 75,65,55,45,35,25 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+75^\circ+65^\circ+55^\circ+45^\circ+35^\circ+25^\circ&=360^\circ\\\angle AOB+300^\circ&=360^\circ\\\angle AOB&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^\circ$.
